description: This file contains functions for generating precoding matrix tables for different antenna port configurations in a wireless communication system, including codebook generation for SSB, PDCCH, CSI-RS, PDSCH, and handling multiple port configurations (1, 2, and 4 ports). It defines static functions for creating specific precoding matrices and assembling them into tables, and a main function to generate these tables based on the number of antenna ports.

classes.name: precoding_matrix_mapper
classes.description: Class representing a mapper for precoding matrices, used to map sector IDs and port configurations to specific precoding matrices.

classes.name: precoding_matrix_repository
classes.description: Class representing a repository of precoding matrices, storing the generated matrices for use in transmission.

methods.name: generate_precoding_matrix_tables
methods.description: Main function to generate precoding matrix tables based on the number of antenna ports and sector ID.
